description.en: Kagawa Prefecture is a prefecture of Japan located on the island of Shikoku. Kagawa Prefecture has a population of 949,358 and is the smallest prefecture by geographic area at 1,877 square kilometres .
description.zh-CN: 香川縣是位於日本四國島東北部瀨戶內海沿岸的一個縣，縣廳位於高松市。「香川」這一縣名取自於位於香川縣中部的「香川郡」，轄區範圍相當於古代令制國中的讚岐國。
